optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Plant Procurement Manager, Industrial Gas Supply Network

professionalSummary.text: Eight years of procurement experience in heavy industry, including five years in plant procurement and two years as a purchasing assistant at an engineering distributor.
professionalSummary.witness: "Five years in plant procurement at a regional cement producer, the last two as the buyer for three plants' maintenance parts and contracted services under the group procurement policy, reporting to the plant procurement team leader."

experienceHighlights.text: Led the procurement team for three plants, managing maintenance parts and contracted services under the group procurement policy.
experienceHighlights.witness: "the last two as the buyer for three plants' maintenance parts and contracted services under the group procurement policy, reporting to the plant procurement team leader."

experienceHighlights.text: Operated a documented supplier risk process for critical parts, maintaining a supplier register and conducting quarterly risk reviews with plant maintenance managers.
experienceHighlights.witness: "Operated the supplier risk process for the three plants' critical parts, keeping the critical supplier register and the quarterly risk review with the plant maintenance managers."

experienceHighlights.text: Supported capital equipment tenders above the delegated limit, preparing tender documents and bid comparisons for kiln refurbishment, with submissions to the group tender board.
experienceHighlights.witness: "Supported the capital equipment tenders run by the team leader for the kiln refurbishment, preparing the tender documents and the bid comparison; the tender board submissions were made by the team leader."

experienceHighlights.text: Authored annual procurement boundary notes for each plant and closed two internal audit findings on purchase order controls in 2024.
experienceHighlights.witness: "Wrote the annual procurement boundary note for each of the three plants and closed the two internal audit findings raised against the plants' purchase order controls in 2024."

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Critical supplier register, quarterly risk review pack, kiln refurbishment bid comparison, and audit closure memo available as work samples.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: "Work sample: the critical supplier register and the quarterly risk review pack for one plant, the bid comparison for the kiln refurbishment tender and the audit closure memo for the two 2024 findings, with the purchase order system references as a verification trail."

skills.text: Supplier risk management, procurement policy compliance, capital equipment tendering, audit findings resolution, team leadership.
